title: Easter Bible Crossword Puzzle — He Is Risen
heading: The Easter Bible Crossword
description: An Easter Bible crossword from Matthew 28: the empty tomb, the angel at the grave, and resurrection morning. Play Holy Week puzzles free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: An angel at the grave, linen cloths lying folded, and a tomb that could not hold Him — He Is Risen turns resurrection morning into a crossword you can solve in one sitting. Every clue points back to Matthew 28: Peter running to the tomb, the garden nearby, the victory over death.
The archive carries the whole arc of Holy Week: The Last Supper, The Garden of Gethsemane, The Crucifixion, and The Road to Emmaus — a puzzle for each day leading to the empty tomb.

clues.text: Apostle who ran to the empty tomb
Place near where the tomb was set
Cloths left lying in the tomb

verseText: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
